The single database is a single point of failure in series with everything. Fix the weakest link first.
Availability is MTBF / (MTBF + MTTR). Faster repair means less downtime per failure. That's rapidity at work.
Each extra nine is ten times less downtime: 8.76 hours down to about 53 minutes.
